search_and_update_rules.name: Replace initials X coordinate of 23.37 with 23.47
Replace initials X coordinate of 23.37 with 23.47

notes.rule_modes: Two modes: (1) search-based using search_column+search_value+update_column, (2) direct cell using target_cell
notes.target_cell: Optional. Directly replace a specific cell (e.g. 'B3') with target_value, regardless of its current content. When set, search_column/search_value/update_column are not needed.
notes.search_column: The column to search for the search_value (search-based mode only)
notes.search_value: The value to find in the search_column (search-based mode only)
notes.update_column: The column to check and potentially update in the same row (search-based mode only)
notes.target_value: The desired value to write. Used by both modes.
